Stock dropped approx. 13% to $13.21 following news interpreted as delayed disclosure around the Phase 3 REGAL/GPS trial's 80th-event threshold

catalysts.headline: Licensing partner 3D Medicines reports the Phase 3 REGAL (galinpepimut-S) trial event count at 78 of the 80 pre-specified events as of this settlement date; final analysis is triggered once the 80th event occurs
catalysts.note: Secondary/aggregator sourced (German-language coverage); not independently confirmed against a primary release. Relevant context for the Aug/Sept 2026 disclosure-timing controversy already on file, but does not itself confirm whether the 80th event had occurred by the time of those events.

catalysts.headline: SELLAS reports Q2 2026 financial results: net loss $9.6M ($0.05/share) vs $6.6M ($0.07/share) in Q2 2025; cash $138.3M as of 2026-06-30; Phase 2 SLS009 (1L AML) fully enrolled at 28 patients with topline data expected Q4 2026; Phase 3 REGAL (GPS, AML) final analysis to occur after the 80th prespecified event

notes: As of 2026-08-18 (per licensing partner 3D Medicines), the REGAL trial had reached 78 of 80 required events -- still short of the 80th-event threshold that was reportedly already a subject of disclosure-delay allegations in Aug/Sept 2026 coverage (already on file); this timing tension is unresolved and flagged for a follow-up pass. Hong Kong arbitration with 3D Medicines over ~$13M in disputed milestone payments was reported with a ruling 'expected' in Q3 2026, but no outcome was located this session and no reliable date exists, so it is omitted from dated catalysts. Unconfirmed market speculation about a possible company sale (tied to revised change-of-control executive pay terms) was also not independently dated or confirmed, so omitted from catalysts per the dated-catalyst rule.
